elements_not_encoded.reason: No SNOMED concept for home infection-control challenges (only 'Infection control status' finding, which is not specific).

elements_not_encoded.text: Any condition that would be better managed in an inpatient setting
elements_not_encoded.reason: Open-ended clinical judgement; no finding can express it.
No concept for unstable social circumstances; 'Social problem not due to a mental disorder' considered too broad/different.
No 'patient requests admission' concept; 'Patient requests a hospital referral' (situation) exists but is a referral, not admission.

judgment_calls.decision: Encoded as Urgent, following Will's convention that the red box becomes Urgent.
judgment_calls.alternatives: The box says 'discuss or refer to hospital for admission', not 'urgent attention'; some items (adherence difficulty, BMI < 18) are not time-critical. Could be left without a priority (but then the check_for findings would need another consumer).

judgment_calls.topic: Symptoms row as a second priority rule
judgment_calls.decision: The Symptoms row says 'give urgent attention and refer'; encoded as a separate Urgent rule.
Only BMI < 18 encoded (kg/m²); Hb not representable. Rule fires less often than the page intends.
Any Hemoptysis triggers the symptom-row Urgent rule; '≥ 1 tablespoon fresh' not representable (fires more often).
